title: Cloud Computing
description: Cloud computing with AWS covering EC2, S3, IAM, RDS, VPC, security, DNS, deployment, monitoring, and backup strategies.
learning_outcomes: Understand cloud computing concepts and service models
Provision and manage AWS EC2 instances
Use AWS S3 for object storage and CDN
Implement AWS IAM for access control and security
Use AWS RDS for managed relational databases
Design secure VPC architectures with proper networking
